venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL came in -56.4% vs target on Thursday ($895 vs $2,053).** Food $141. Comps $9.75. 32 guests / $27.99 GCA. **Quiet Thursday.** A slight push at the start of shift; opener left a little before 7pm and it went quiet thereafter. The team used downtime to connect with bar guests, detail the dump sink and tap area, and set up the weekend — with a few temporary changes to the well tequila, rum, and rye. Reminder issued to clock the house number in/out at open and close so tips distribute accurately. **Kitchen**: quiet, used the lull to prep for the weekend. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: connecting with Kat, the kitchen manager from Tio Luchos (met during Giving Kitchen), who finally came in. MOD: JK/MKZ. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH came in -55.4% vs target on Thursday ($1,656 vs $3,714) — first night of CMA Fest.** Food $49. Comps $44.60 (2.7%, industry/manager/BINGO credit). 61 guests / $27.14 GCA. **Down-tempo Thursday**; highest volume 9-10pm with steady service after. Charmers next door reported the same. Several guests asked for 'high-energy' venue recs away from Broadway/CMA Fest, and the number arriving at/after close suggests an opportunity for complementary counter-programming in future. **Kitchen**: John-Michael held it down solo. **Maintenance**: kitchen door lock, walk-in door (recurring). 86 Lassi. No incident, no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: a couple (one a regular) on a date left and returned just before close for a nightcap. MOD/Chef: KK & MD // JMS. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR beat target +16.6% on Thursday ($11,184.16 vs $9,594, restaurant net = DC/AM + D&C PM).** Segments: DC/AM $1,281.55, D&C PM $9,902.61. Garden/6A added a further $3,161.93 of regular service (tracked separately; not in restaurant net). Food $2,606. Comps $582.04 (5.2%) — driven by a large comp on one table served alcohol when they don't drink, plus Dave Messenger treats. 158 guests (Tock; excludes Garden, so GCA runs high). **DC/AM (Maggie/Heather)**: Heather rushed it on day-one training; deep-cleaned the scupper to fight flies. **D&C PM**: very slow start, big pop from 8:30pm on; Garden stayed busy and full while the lobby never filled; styled out VIPs and had a great time with Curtis on the floor. **Garden/6A**: chill night with a late pop, big fro-spro day. **Kitchen**: steady little night with Antonio and Marv. **An injury/incident was flagged on the report.** Break make-up not complete; no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: VIPs were thrilled and got to sing the team's praises. Entered by MS.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV restaurant came in -20.7% vs target on Thursday ($3,334 vs $4,203, excl. events); with a $12,000 private event, total EOD net was $15,334.** Food $433 + Bev $2,873. Comps $97 (gifts + F&F). 134 restaurant guests (Sevenrooms) / ~$25 GCA. **Dealmaker event 5-8pm** for ~50 guests ran smoothly (low food interest; they enjoyed the 'Dealmaker' aka Truesight). Only incident: a guest tried to drink their own beer brought in — shut down immediately, warning taken well. Flipped to normal service by 8:45; slow start then hit all at once around 10pm, busy until ~12:30. Welcomed Michael Hall back and several first-timers. **Door**: gradual fill rather than the usual reopen line — completely full by 9:45pm except 10pm reso seats. One no-show (Brett Bechtold, 2 @ 10pm), charged. Menu count 16/16; 1 SOF broken. **Maintenance**: two bar stools. MOD/Chef: Cara/Kyler & Steves. Entered by Marielle.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA came in -18.0% vs target on Thursday ($5,092 vs $6,212, all Marquee; Standing Room dark).** Food $781. Comps $252 (DNLs, misrings, industry, AD+TB+NK+Kenny, Jeffrey). 147 guests / $34.64 GCA. **Eventful night.** Quiet start (~20 covers, slow first two hours) brightened by VIPs Alex, Nick, Tyson, and Kenny at the bar plus barista friends from Concierge; once Angel arrived the room filled and the 20s stayed closed. The kitchen lowboy failed — Julio returned (second time that day) and fixed a second lowboy on the spot; huge save, with Chef Selenia helping coordinate and cover a security break. A guest toured the Standing Room for a potential buyout. Ben's last night — he called it smooth and easy. No-shows charged. **86 tuna.** **Highlight**: comparing airline credit cards with a table that raved about their experience. MOD/Chef: Gigi & Josh/Selenia. Entered by Gigi.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DCDC came in -14.9% vs target on Thursday ($5,763.42 vs $6,770; Marquee only, Garden dark).** Food $837.60. Comps $69.45 (plus $77.27 voids, no waste). 118 guests (46 reservations / 72 walk-in) / $48.84 GCA. **Slow first few hours**, picked up around 7pm with the bulk of reservations before tapering late; the room stayed energetic with a few larger parties and the bar top sat most of the night, into a natural 12:30 last call. **Kitchen**: a big rush around 8pm that James held down like a champ. Went well: new menu, ticket passing, guest connection. To improve: ticket pacing (bar and kitchen), water service, washing lines. No incident; no no-shows charged. **Highlight**: ladies at table 22 calling Tyler 'boy band.' MOD: Corey/Jesse. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG beat target +10.0% on Thursday ($7,699 vs $7,000).** Segments: MB Morning $890 (51 covers), MB Evening $5,471 (150 covers), Sun Club $125, Hot Eye $1,434. Food $2,691. Comps $346. 201 MB OpenTable guests / $38.30 GCA. **Morning (Sam & Lex)**: very slow — first table at 10am; Braden trained with Stephanie, mild lunch, SA cut early. **Evening (Sam/Drew)**: mellow start (~25 on the books) then walk-ins built to 150 covers — a decently busy Thursday with smooth, timely food and drink and lots of happy guests. **Sun Club**: slow first half, good hotel-guest turnout in the warm afternoon. **Hot Eye**: sleepy start, a decent 10pm pop with scad groups and the regular service-industry crew to last call; 86'd 3 menu cocktails. **Kitchen**: smooth, no send-backs — Drew crushing the pass with Isaac and Nate. No incident. **Highlight**: the whole FOH/BOH team getting along and working well. Entered by Alexis.
